points.description: States that an open switch creates a gap/break in the circuit (so the circuit is incomplete/not closed). Equivalent wording accepted, e.g. 'the circuit is broken' or 'not a complete loop'.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating there is a gap or break (incomplete circuit) caused by the open switch. No mark for answers that give only an effect (e.g. 'bulb is off') without mentioning the gap/break/incomplete circuit.
